title: Invert Binary Tree
description:
Mirror the binary tree: swap the left and right child of every node. Return the root.

### Input
- Line 1: `root`, a binary tree in level order, space-separated, with `null` for a missing child (an empty line is an empty tree).

Lists and trees are written like `[1,2,3]` and `[3,9,20,null,null,15,7]` in the examples. The starter code turns them into `ListNode` / `TreeNode` objects for you.

### Output
The returned tree in level order on one line, `null` for missing children, trailing `null`s dropped.

### Constraints
- `0 <= number of nodes <= 100`
- `-100 <= Node.val <= 100`

        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
# ── end node classes ──

    return None


def build_tree(s):
    t = s.split()
    if not t or t[0] == "null":
        return None
    root = TreeNode(int(t[0]))
    q = [root]
    i = 1
    h = 0
    while h < len(q) and i < len(t):
        node = q[h]
        h += 1
        if i < len(t) and t[i] != "null":
            node.left = TreeNode(int(t[i]))
            q.append(node.left)
        i += 1
        if i < len(t) and t[i] != "null":
            node.right = TreeNode(int(t[i]))
            q.append(node.right)
        i += 1
    return root


def tree_str(root):
    parts = []
    q = [root]
    h = 0
    while h < len(q):
        node = q[h]
        h += 1
        if node is None:
            parts.append("null")
            continue
        parts.append(str(node.val))
        q.append(node.left)
        q.append(node.right)
    while parts and parts[-1] == "null":
        parts.pop()
    return " ".join(parts)

    result = solve(root)
    print(tree_str(result))

function readWords(string $s): array {
    return preg_split('/\s+/', trim($s), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

function buildTree(string $s): ?TreeNode {
    $t = readWords($s);
    if (!$t || $t[0] === "null") return null;
    $root = new TreeNode(intval($t[0]));
    $q = [$root];
    $i = 1;
    for ($h = 0; $h < count($q) && $i < count($t); $h++) {
        $n = $q[$h];
        if ($i < count($t) && $t[$i] !== "null") { $n->left = new TreeNode(intval($t[$i])); $q[] = $n->left; }
        $i++;
        if ($i < count($t) && $t[$i] !== "null") { $n->right = new TreeNode(intval($t[$i])); $q[] = $n->right; }
        $i++;
    }
    return $root;
}

function treeStr(?TreeNode $root): string {
    $q = [$root];
    $parts = [];
    for ($h = 0; $h < count($q); $h++) {
        $n = $q[$h];
        if ($n === null) { $parts[] = "null"; continue; }
        $parts[] = (string)$n->val;
        $q[] = $n->left;
        $q[] = $n->right;
    }
    while ($parts && end($parts) === "null") array_pop($parts);
    return implode(" ", $parts);
}

def solve(root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
    # Return the root of the mirrored tree.
    stack = [root] if root is not None else []
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        node.left, node.right = node.right, node.left

        if node.right is not None:
            stack.append(node.right)
